integrity: The range theorem is proved constructively by reducing inversion to a strictly increasing one-variable equation. The Jacobian factorization was independently checked algebraically, and substitution checks over extreme positive data were used only as non-proof verification.
scientific_limitations: Single proper subsegment of a known circle chord only. The result does not solve multi-segment pairing, general observation-curve reconstruction, or uniform noise stability near parameter-space boundaries. A 2017 predecessor proves injectivity from the same endpoint derivative formulas; the new claim is the full positive-quadrant range classification, global analytic coordinate theorem, and exact Jacobian.
title: Positive-quadrant coordinates for a segment from visual-angle cusp slopes
